name: freight-stations-rats-fork
title: Freight Stations (UndeadRat22 fork)
author: UndeadRat22
description: Ragingart's Freight Stations rebuilt around a minimal core: long containers and tanks beside your trains, sharing one fixed-size inventory per group and joined by balancers. Stations build anywhere, undo and blueprints work natively, and flipped pastes build the exact mirrored row. Breaking: saves from 0.12.x/0.13.x do not migrate. Do not run alongside the original.
